interfaceScale.label: Interface scale
interfaceScale.description: Resize text, buttons, and panels. Saved in this browser or app on this device.

accessDenied.title: Microphone access denied
accessDenied.description: Grant microphone permission to choose an input device.

permissionPrompt.description: Microphone permission needed to list and choose an input device.

meter.hint: The level meter activates once you join a voice channel.

device.unsupported: This browser doesn't support choosing an output device. Audio plays to the system default.

permissionPrompt.description: Grant microphone permission to list output devices (browsers gate output names behind microphone access).

accessDenied.title: Camera access denied
accessDenied.description: Grant camera permission to choose a camera.

blocked.browser: Camera blocked at browser level. Click the camera icon in your browser's address bar, reset the permission, then click Try again.
blocked.mac: Grant camera access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera, then restart the app.
blocked.windows: Grant camera access in Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera, then restart the app.
blocked.other: Camera permission was denied. Reset it in your browser/Chromium prompt and try again.

permissionPrompt.description: Camera permission needed to choose a camera and preview.

previewError.inUse: Camera is in use by another application.

quality.title: Video quality
quality.target: Sending up to {{res}} at {{fps}} fps, up to {{mbps}} Mbps (H.264, hardware-encoded where your GPU supports it).
quality.belowPreset: This camera does not offer the chosen resolution, so Emix uses the highest it offers. Nothing is upscaled.
quality.startPreview: Start the preview to see what this camera can deliver.
quality.adaptive: If a viewer's connection or device cannot keep up, they automatically receive a lower layer.

messageSound.label: Play sound for every message
messageSound.description: Off (default): only DMs and messages that mention you. On: every channel.

showOnSwitch.label: Show floating window during calls
showOnSwitch.description: While you are in a voice channel or call and look at something else, a small window keeps the call in view.

noiseSuppression.label: AI Noise Suppression
noiseSuppression.description: ML-based noise removal (RNNoise). Filters keyboard, fans and background noise.

echoCancellation.label: Echo Cancellation
echoCancellation.description: Cancels echo from your speakers feeding back into the mic. Always on for voice channels and calls.

autoGain.label: Auto Gain Control
autoGain.description: Auto-adjusts mic volume. Can cause voice ducking during streams.

detached.notice: This account is detached from its home instance.
detached.explanation: {{homeInstance}} was reset or is no longer available, so this account now operates locally on this instance. Your profile and password are managed here.
detached.reattachHint: As {{username}} on {{homeInstance}}, you can re-link this account. Profile and presence will sync from there again.

profile.animatedTooLarge: Animated images can be up to {{max}} MB.

status.label: Status
status.homeUnavailable: Your status is kept on {{host}}. Connect to {{host}} to change it.

password.tooShort: New password must be at least {{min}} characters

danger.description: Once you delete your account, there is no going back. Your messages will remain but be attributed to "Deleted User".

warning.headline: This will permanently delete your account.
warning.spaces: All space memberships will be removed
warning.friends: All friend connections will be removed
warning.dms: All DM memberships will be removed
warning.messages: Your messages will remain but be attributed to "Deleted User"

ownedSpaces.prompt_one: You own {{count}} space. Handle each before continuing:
ownedSpaces.prompt_other: You own {{count}} spaces. Handle each before continuing:

confirm.permanent: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

federation.removing: Removing your account from connected instances…

discovery.label: Allow others to find my profile
discovery.description: When enabled, your profile appears in Discover People. Others can always add you by exact username.

activity.label: Share Activity Status
activity.description: Allow others to see what you're up to, like games you're playing or music you're listening to.

portal.description: On Wayland, the desktop manages all Emix shortcuts. Assign, change or remove keys in the system's keyboard shortcut settings, under Emix. Local browser/X11 bindings are not used here.
portal.idle: Preparing first-time registration of all available actions.
portal.pending: Connecting to the desktop portal. If a system dialog appears, choose shortcuts for the actions you want to use.
portal.ready: Emix is registered. Open your system's keyboard shortcut settings to change or remove assignments. The list below is read-only and refreshes when you return to Emix.
portal.unavailable: The portal is unavailable, permission was denied, or the session ended. A Global Shortcuts portal backend is required. Local bindings are disabled on Wayland.

note.webOnly: Shortcuts work while this tab is focused. For global shortcuts that work in other apps, use the desktop app.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Permission Required
accessibility.description: Emix needs Accessibility permission for global shortcuts to work outside the app.

hookError.title: Global Shortcuts Unavailable
hookError.description: Failed to start input listener. On Linux, your user may need to be in the input group.

openAtLogin.label: Start at boot
openAtLogin.description: Automatically launch Emix when you log in

startMinimized.label: Start minimized
startMinimized.description: Start hidden in the system tray instead of showing the window

updates.upToDate: You are on the latest version
updates.idle: Check for new versions of the desktop app
updates.external: Updates are installed through your Flatpak software manager
updates.manualNote: This build cannot install updates itself, so new versions are downloaded from GitHub and replace the app by hand. See the release notes for the steps on your platform.
updates.externalNote: Flatpak applies updates atomically outside the app. Use your software manager or the flatpak update command to update Emix.

desktopDownload.title: Desktop
desktopDownload.intro: Global keybinds, start at boot and a system tray icon.
desktopDownload.unsupported: The desktop app runs on Windows, Linux and macOS.

covers.mac: Runs on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs
covers.linux: AppImage or deb package, x64 or arm64

archGuessed.windows: Your browser did not say which processor this PC has, so x64 is preselected.
archGuessed.mac: Your browser did not say which chip this Mac has, so Apple Silicon is preselected.
archGuessed.linux: Your browser did not say which processor this machine has, so x64 is preselected.

profileStudio.title: Profile
profileStudio.subtitle: Make your profile yours: name colours, nameplates, decorations, backgrounds and effects. Everything here is free for everyone.
profileStudio.replica: This account's profile is managed by its home instance, so these settings can't be saved here.

looks.title: Looks
looks.hint: Start from a complete look, then fine-tune it below. Your pronouns, links and images are kept.
looks.local: Saved looks are kept on this device.

name.title: Name style
name.hint: How your display name appears in chat, member lists, friends, voice channels and your profile. Space role colours still take priority inside a space.
name.lowContrast: Very dark colours are brightened automatically so your name stays readable.

nameplate.title: Nameplate
nameplate.hint: Shown behind your name in member lists, friends, direct messages and voice channels.

decoration.title: Avatar decoration
decoration.hint: A frame around your profile picture, shown wherever your avatar is large enough.

banner.title: Banner framing
banner.hint: Choose which part of your banner shows. Animated GIF banners play on your profile.
banner.noBanner: You haven't added a banner yet.
banner.openAccount: Change banner, avatar or display name in My Account

background.title: Profile background
background.hint: Colours or an image behind your whole profile card. Text always gets a dark overlay so it stays readable.
background.imageHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or animated GIF, up to {{max}} MB.
background.notImage: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF image.
background.tooLarge: That image is larger than {{max}} MB.
background.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded. Try again.

effect.title: Profile effect
effect.hint: A short animation that plays when someone opens your profile.

about.title: About you
about.hint: Shown on your profile card. Links open in a new tab.
about.editBio: Edit your bio and status in My Account

motion.title: Animations
motion.label: Play profile animations
motion.hint: Applies on this device. Animations also stop when your system asks for reduced motion.
